prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Sign-in & account: Post-adoption sign-in timing, account recovery copy, and multi-device sync banners won; moving sign-in post-waiting hurt, while sync hints and notices showed no clear effect.
Path selection: Headline clarity updates, spotlight layouts, and story stage visual redesigns won; checklist layouts and story scroll redesigns hurt, while value refreshes and copy simplifications showed no clear effect.
Waiting room: Interactive waiting rooms, readiness/visibility status checks, and spawn location hints won; 3D trackers, completion timers, progress indicators, and sound notifications showed no clear effect.
Adoption flow: Split upload companion previews paired with photo quality guides won; compact grids, guidelines banners, stamp redesigns, and multi-step inspection or fallback flows hurt, while pre-adoption reviews showed no clear effect.
Finish & placement: Interactive spawn placement flows, desktop placement verification screens, and system tray location tips won; direct controls guides, guided spawn stages, and first interaction tips hurt, while welcome stage redesigns and retrieval callouts showed no clear effect.
Predictions accuracy: Predictions underpredicted counter-intuitive flow wins (such as placement verification screens and interactive spawn flows) and overpredicted outcomes on severe failures (such as stamp redesigns, direct controls guides, and guided spawn stages).

Changes:
0: [home, new_screen] Desktop Environment Compatibility Verification Screen: Introduce a dedicated desktop readiness verification screen before waiting room that checks display resolution and desktop layer compatibility. (why: 3 support tickets reported pets failing to appear on the desktop or the app stalling. Verifying system environment early reduces launch failures.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Cloud Sync Account Safety Notice: Add an explicit cloud sync preservation badge and hint on the sign-in screen reassuring returning users that existing pets will not be overwritten. (why: 8 support emails were received about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
2: [home, wait_info] Background Desktop Hatching Activity Banner: Display background rendering time estimates and progress indicators on the waiting room screen. (why: Waiting stage mean time is 2336s; users need clear feedback while assets render in the background.)
3: [finish, notification] Desktop Tray Launcher Notification Prompt: Add a delayed notification tip carousel on the final welcome screen explaining system tray controls. (why: 3 support tickets reported confusion on how to control, hide, or interact with the pet after setup.)
4: [choose_path, copy] Story Experience Value Proposition Headline: Update the story intro headline and body text to clearly explain the benefits of having an interactive desktop companion. (why: 13% of users drop off before path choice, with high mean time (514s) spent contemplating.)
5: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Desktop Placement Redesign: Redesign the home intro screen into a full-bleed layout featuring an animated mascot welcome and immediate interaction instructions. (why: Finish stage mean duration is 5815s with 17.7% drop-off; clear final guidance ensures smooth transition into active app usage.)
